description: WebMCP Retail demo — accessories store with WebMCP + AG-UI custom agent support

tools.name: login
tools.title: Login
tools.description: Signs the user in via PingOne. Ask the user for their account email address in chat first, then pass it as the email parameter — the user confirms it on one click and completes out-of-band verification in the opened sign-in window (e.g. approving on their phone). This tool polls until sign-in completes. Only usable when signed out.

email.description: The user's email address — ask the user for it in chat before calling this tool.

tools.name: view_products
tools.title: View Products
tools.description: Fetches the product catalog from the backend API. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add to Cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the shopping cart by product ID and quantity.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: View Cart
tools.description: Returns the current cart contents and total as JSON. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.title: Remove from Cart
tools.description: Removes a product entirely from the cart by product ID. Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.

tools.name: checkout
tools.title: Checkout
tools.description: POSTs the cart to the checkout API using the user's access_token as a Bearer credential. Shows an in-page confirmation modal that the user must approve before the request is sent. Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.
